name: Yü Kuo-pao
bio: Yü Kuo-pao (俞國寶; Yu Guobao; 12th century) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 风入松 (Feng ru song)
poems.author: Yü Kuo-pao
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
一春长费买花钱。
日日醉花边。
玉骢惯识西湖路，骄嘶过、沽酒垆前。
红杏香中箫鼓，绿杨影里秋千。
暖风十里丽人天。
花压髻云偏。
画船载取春归去，馀情寄、湖水湖烟。
明日重扶残醉，来寻陌上花钿。
